title: Task 1: Add GitHub webhook HMAC signature verification
description:
Add security verification for GitHub webhooks using HMAC SHA-256 signatures.

## CONTEXT: WHY THIS IS NEEDED
Currently ANY external service can POST to /api/github/webhooks/pr and /api/github/webhooks/push.
This is a security hole - someone could spam fake webhook events.
GitHub signs all webhook requests with X-Hub-Signature-256 header using a shared secret.
We need to verify this signature before processing webhooks.

## WHAT YOU WILL DO
1. Add GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET to backend/src/config.ts
2. Create signature verification function in github-webhooks.routes.ts
3. Add middleware before webhook route handlers
4. Test with valid and invalid signatures

LINE 48 has TODO comment: '// TODO: Implement HMAC signature verification'
You will add code BEFORE this line in the route handler.

FILE: backend/src/config.ts  
You will add new environment variable here following existing pattern.
